PROVENANCE: The Coca-Cola Company (KO) -- Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter
ended June 27, 2025 (calendar Q2 2025). SEC accession number
0000021344-25-000061, filed 2025-07-24. Primary document:
https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000061/ko-20250627.htm
Excerpts below are copied VERBATIM from the filed document (HTML tables
flattened row-by-row into plain-text lines -- the shape a PDF text layer
yields -- with the hidden inline-XBRL <ix:header> metadata block stripped,
since that block is never visible text and no PDF text layer would contain
it). Four sections: cover page, consolidated statement of income,
consolidated balance sheet, consolidated statement of cash flows. Column
order in the income statement is Three Months Ended (current, prior-year),
then Six Months Ended (current, prior-year) -- a different YTD span (six
months, not Apple's nine) than the other US fixture. The income statement
also carries a consolidated pre-NCI subtotal ("Consolidated Net Income")
ABOVE the true bottom line ("Net Income Attributable to Shareowners") --
both contain the literal substring "net income", exercising the
extractor's first-match-wins net-income read against a name close to, but
not exactly, the real bottom line.
